name: Interac e-Transfer / Email Money Transfer (EMT) Gateway for WooCommerce
author: IpodGuy79

sections.description:
A straightforward EMT / Interac e-Transfer gateway for Canadian WooCommerce stores. Supports both Classic and Block Checkout—no extra extensions required.

Features
– WooCommerce Blocks and Classic checkout support
– Random or static secret answers
– Instructions on the Thank You page, order emails, and My Account
– Placeholders: [order], [answer], [discount]
– Optional discount when customers choose EMT
– Customizable checkout title and helper text
– Debug mode
– Fully translatable

How it works
1. Customer selects “Interac e-Transfer / Email Money Transfer (EMT)” at checkout.
2. Your instructions display on the Thank You page and in order emails.
3. You confirm the deposit and complete the order.

Notes
– Built for Canadian stores using WooCommerce.
– No paid add-ons required.
– Formerly titled “Advanced EMT Payment Gateway.”

Credits

Built in Canada by ipodguy79
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/advanced-emt-payment-gateway/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments, enable Interac e-Transfer / Email Money Transfer (EMT), and configure options.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. Native support is included.

Will customers see EMT instructions?

Yes. They appear on the Thank You page, in order emails, and in My Account.

Can I offer a discount for using EMT?

Yes. Set a percentage discount in the plugin settings.

What placeholders can I use in the instructions?

[order] = order number, [answer] = secret answer, [discount] = discount percentage (if enabled).

Is this plugin free?

Yes. All features are included.
